reason: A read-only DSH sidebar monitor that presents live host, process, network, disk, and Docker container status in overview, process, and container views.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中以只读方式展示主机资源、进程、网络、磁盘和 Docker 容器状态。
summaries.en: A read-only DSH sidebar monitor for viewing live host resources, processes, network, disks, and Docker container status.

capabilities: Reads host CPU, memory, disk, network, process, and Docker container metrics through whitelisted RPC endpoints
Reads configured host filesystem and Docker socket mounts when available
Displays and can open or copy published Docker port addresses
